<reason>CON won a close, high-quality clash by forcing PRO to admit Ethiopia must slow in a collapse, then showing the leftover dispute is who verifies that trigger. Self-judged filling by the party that holds the reservoir and turbines is a weak duty, and CON’s postponement-versus-unrefundable-harvest weighing beat PRO’s sovereignty slogans. PRO stayed closer to the motion and scored with delay-as-veto, but did not kill the auditor problem. Three clipped CON speeches keep the margin modest.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>A’s R2: taking B’s “slow if inflow collapses” concession and recasting the debate as unaudited self-certification versus a pre-agreed hydrological floor.</best_rebuttal>
